fundamental.summary: No actionable signals detected across insider, institutional, government, lobbying, or retail channels; earnings in 75 days presents timing risk with minimal conviction support.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (413.28), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and same-day CPI event create severe macro headwinds for Health Care equities despite 75-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term bullish confluence (supertrend, hull, psar) with price near support (127.63) and contrarian fear-zone opportunity in oversold conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis 413.28, same-day CPI event, rising dollar), price below all major moving averages (50/200 SMA/EMA), weak trend structure (low ADX), overbought stochRSI, and zero fundamental conviction create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
